cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come paint Dad's kitchen with me. Since he died, I barely see you. Don't tell me you've forgotten the roller technique I taught you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay someone. I can't paint over his height marks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At last, you're looking before you paint. We'll tape round them. Come and hold the end for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probably just sit on the floor and cry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then bring tissues instead of a roller. You always came to lessons overprepared; I could use that today. Just come. I'll sit with you.
